Flex-wrap and align-content

flex-wrap permits multiple flex lines; align-content distributes extra cross-axis space between
those lines.

Interview question: What is the difference between align-items and align-content?

Answer: align-items aligns items within each line; align-content distributes the lines
themselves.
Remember: Wrap creates lines; content aligns lines.
